answer: An applicant locks 13.6 POA for four closes, then proves identity on dune transect 19. The public post emits five 11-byte hashes; replies must come from one registered mirror station, each signing hash n XOR the prior reply 55-70 seconds after the emit. Auditors replay all five signatures against the post tape and station log and reject a second station on that transect. An 8,000-key farm needs 108,800 POA and 8,000 exclusive stations. An early, reused, or missing reply burns 61% of the bond and bars the key for seven epochs. That delayed spiral of XORs cannot be pre-signed by a clone crew.
